attributes.content: Our own brand, and the brands we distribute.

attributes.text: Alongside our own-label Sanam range, we supply trusted names like Shan, Green Leaf and The Lemon Tree to foodservice, retail and wholesale customers across the UK and Europe.
Select a brand to see its range.
Own brand · rice, flour & quality foods
Sanam is our flagship own-label range of premium rice, flour and quality food products, packed on our own production line in Birmingham, which we have run since the 1970s.
We offer custom packaging and branding for retail and food service customers. Your brand, our quality.
